text:
A few of us were travelling around Paris together, and we wanted to do something different from visiting museums, shopping streets and the usual attractions. Normandy was suggested because we were all interested in history and after discussing the options we decided to book a private trip with Win Transfer Paris.

title: Incredible Normandy Experience
text: Instead of joining a crowded bus, we booked a private Normandy tour, and it exceeded every expectation. We visited Omaha Beach, the American Cemetery, and several charming villages at our own pace. Our driver was courteous, professional, and flexible throughout the day. The comfortable vehicle made the long drive enjoyable, and we never felt rushed. It became our favorite day in France.
